# Robots.txt for Real Result Marketing (https://realresult.in)
# Designed for Optimal Search Engine and AI Generative Crawler Indexation
# Content Signals Specification: https://contentsignals.org/ (IETF draft-romm-aipref-contentsignals)

Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /private/
